action.command: cd /workspace && C=$(curl -s -i --max-time 20 -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"superadmin@buildplace.io","password":"somepassword"}' | grep -i '^set-cookie:' | sed 's/set-cookie: //I' | cut -d';' -f1); curl -s --max-time 20 -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/graphql -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Cookie: $C" -d '{"query":"query { user(id:\"ciNqPMtcHmsOI6i2PO5cp\") { id email firstName lastName } }"}'

tool_call.name: terminal
